global.defaultHtml:
All work, materials, services, and deliveries shall comply with the project documents, approved scopes, applicable laws, codes, and site requirements.

Recipients are responsible for reviewing quantities, schedules, exclusions, and clarifications before proceeding.

rfq.defaultHtml:
Quotes must include all materials, labor, equipment, delivery, taxes, exclusions, and lead times required to complete the requested scope.

Submitted pricing is subject to review against the RFQ documents, project requirements, and any issued clarifications.

purchaseOrder.defaultHtml:
All materials, labor, equipment, and services shall comply with the approved purchase order, project specifications, and applicable codes.

The vendor is responsible for confirming quantities, delivery dates, and site requirements before fulfillment.

Invoices must reference the purchase order number and are subject to verification against delivered goods or completed services.

subChangeOrder.defaultHtml:
This sub change order modifies the referenced purchase order only to the extent described in this document.

All changed work, materials, pricing, schedule impact, and supporting documentation are subject to project review and approval.

Invoices must reference the SCO number and linked purchase order number where applicable.
